title: P5-12: Retire the old app, backends and Papyrus special cases; migration record and docs
description:
## Goal
Retire the old p.apyr.us deployment and the Papyrus repo's production special cases, record the migration, and leave docs current. Human-run runbook; nothing is deleted without Ryan's explicit yes. Done 7 days after the cutover is quiet.

## Context (FACT)
- Old resources: Amplify app dbsyytcm9drqa (branches `main`, `codex-rehydration-api-split`), backend stacks `amplify-dbsyytcm9drqa-main-branch-cb38ada667` and `amplify-dbsyytcm9drqa-codexrehydrationapisplit-branch-21b76655cb` (98 stacks counting nested), buckets `amplify-dbsyytcm9drqa-*` (6: 2 media, 2 code, 2 introspection), 2 S3 Vectors buckets, Cognito pools us-east-1_40Uot7WSv and us-east-1_GxxvFqQTQ, SSM params under /amplify/dbsyytcm9drqa/, the old ECR responder image reference, SES rule set `papyrus-inbound-p-apyr-us` (if still owned by the old stack).
- Papyrus repo special cases: `amplify/backend.ts` `productionAppId: "dbsyytcm9drqa"` (C5), root `amplify.yml` build, `amplify/auth/resource.ts` default redirect URLs, console responder IAM paths for dbsyytcm9drqa, scripts with hardcoded function names.
- docs/site-hosting.md lists "importing Pilobolus corpus data into the p.apyr.us app (dbsyytcm9drqa)" as an anti-pattern; docs/standard-site.md 3.1 plans reconnecting the old app and must be rewritten to what was done.

## Exact steps
1. Ryan yes (list of resources shown with the commands). Disable old app builds; take a final export (S3 manifest, DynamoDB on-demand backups or `export-table-to-point-in-time` of the 22 non-empty tables) to a private bucket or local archive; record locations.
2. Delete in order: codex branch, old main branch (backend stack deletion removes data), app, leftover stacks, vector buckets, pools, SSM params, orphan buckets (empty first; `corpora/pilobol-us` already decided in P5-09), GitHub token secret `amplify/github-app-token` only if no site uses it any more (Pilobol.us and TI done first).
3. Papyrus PR: remove the `papyrus` brand duplicate and `productionAppId` special cases, root `amplify.yml` deploy role for p.apyr.us (Papyrus main stops deploying anything), update scripts that hardcode old function names.
4. Docs PR: `docs/migrations/p-apyr-us.md` (the record, mirrors pilobol-us.md), rewrite standard-site.md 3.1, site-hosting.md, README link; close PPY-228e8d as superseded and the phase tickets.

## Acceptance checks
- `aws amplify list-apps` no longer shows dbsyytcm9drqa; `cloudformation list-stacks` has none with `dbsyytcm9drqa`; new site still passes the P5-11 smoke checks after deletion (SES and Slack unaffected).
- Papyrus repo CI green; `git grep dbsyytcm9drqa` finds only the migration record.
- Backup archive location recorded in this ticket.

## Rollback
After deletion: restore from the archive into a new stack (days of work); that is why deletion waits 7 days and the archive is taken first.

## Risks
Deleting the wrong shared resource (the SES rule set or MX now owned by the new stack: check ownership first); the shared GitHub token secret.

## Needs Ryan
Yes to every deletion and the Papyrus/docs PR merges.
right_now_summary: The old app awaits Ryan’s approval, backups, cleanup, and documentation updates.
